{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("Columns:", data.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Display QA orders
print("\nQA orders:")
print(qa_orders.head())"}
